page.overview:
Who is 4904 Elephant?

4904 Elephant is a Promotional Life Cereal set released in 2005.

The set features mainly light grey pieces, reflecting the elephant's skin colour, however it also has black and dark grey pieces for the feet, ears, eyes and the end of the trunk. One white piece is used for the elephant's tusks. The ears are able to be moved due to them clipping on to the body, and the end of the trunk can be adjusted. The set also includes instructions to use the pieces to build a Walrus.
